title: Dental PPO Tier-Difference Credits After a Dependent Leaves — Premium Billing Accounts
content:
**Scope.** On Premium Billing Accounts, this rule governs the tier-difference credit for a Dental PPO Plans plan unit whose coverage tier dropped because a dependent's dental enrollment ended for loss of eligibility — and only for such a drop. Cascade gives back the part of the dental premium that was billed at a coverage tier the household no longer has.

**When it is due.** The credit is owed once the records show that a dependent's Dental PPO Plans enrollment funded by the account ended for loss of eligibility. It is booked on the account by the agent.

**Business effect.** The credit is recorded on the account's billing ledger as a premium credit on the dental line, marked as a plan-change difference credit — a dental-line plan-change difference credit — dated the booking day, posted against the coverage month of the invoice issued last, carrying the number of coverage months it gives back and the amount; it lowers the account's current balance by that amount.

## Booking tool — `book_dental_tier_credit_2a6e4a9b`

The agent unlocks `book_dental_tier_credit_2a6e4a9b` and then calls it; one call records one credit.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `billing_account_id` | reference number of the premium billing account the credit is booked to, as returned by the billing-account lookup for the customer | identifier |
| `coverage_month` | coverage month of the invoice the credit is posted against | YYYY-MM, no day part |
| `months_covered` | number of coverage months the credit gives back | whole number |
| `credit_amount` | amount credited back, in USD | positive, 2 decimal places; more places are rounded half up to the cent when booked |

**Receipt.** `billing_txn_id` (ledger reference of the new credit), `billing_account_id`, `product_line` (always `dental_ppo`), `credit_reason` (always `plan_change_difference`), `coverage_month` (YYYY-MM), `months_covered` (integer), `amount` (USD, 2 decimals), `txn_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `balance_due` (USD, 2 decimals; negative means a credit balance). A receipt carrying `billing_txn_id` means the credit is on the ledger.
